# Autodrive

Basically a mashup of `Hyperdrive` and `Autobase`. It lets multiple people write to the same file system at the same time.

## What it does

- Feels just like normal Hyperdrive (`put`, `get`, `list`).
- Multiple devices can collaborate without stepping on each other's toes thanks to Autobase.
- You can easily share the discovery key so friends can hop in.
- Automatically handles any messy conflicts for you.

## Usage

```javascript
const { create_autodrive } = require('autodrive')
const Corestore = require('corestore')

const store = new Corestore('./storage')

// Create a new autodrive
const drive = create_autodrive(store)
await drive.ready()

// Join an existing autodrive
const drive = create_autodrive(store, existing_key)
await drive.ready()

// Write to the drive
await drive.put('/hello.txt', Buffer.from('Hello world!'))

// Read from the drive
const content = await drive.get('/hello.txt')
console.log(content.toString())

// Add a writer to collaborate
await drive.add_writer(peer_writer_key)
```
